## `sindr/examples/parse_netlist.rs`

```rust
//! Parse a SPICE3 netlist and solve it.
//!
//! Run with the `spice` feature enabled:
//!
//! ```text
//! cargo run --example parse_netlist --features spice
//! ```
//!
//! Demonstrates the full `sindr::spice` flow: parse a deck into a
//! `Circuit`, dispatch the deck's analysis directives to the matching
//! solver routine, and render a parse error with miette's fancy reporter.

use sindr::spice::{parse_str, parse_str_with_options, AnalysisRequest, ParseOptions};

// A resistor divider plus `.dc` sweep, `.tf` and `.sens` directives. V1 = 9 V across
// R1 = 1k / R2 = 2k, so node `n2` sits at 6 V at the nominal source value.
const DECK: &str = "* resistor divider\n\
                    V1 n1 0 DC 9\n\
                    R1 n1 n2 1k\n\
                    R2 n2 0 2k\n\
                    .dc V1 0 9 0.9\n\
                    .tf V(n2) V1\n\
                    .sens V(n2)\n\
                    .end\n";

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    // 1. Parse (strict mode). The result is a plain `sindr::Circuit`
    //    plus the deck's analysis directives.
    let netlist = parse_str(DECK)?;
    println!(
        "parsed `{}` — {} components, {} analyses",
        netlist.title,
        netlist.circuit.components.len(),
        netlist.analyses.len()
    );

    // 2. Solve the operating point directly.
    let op = sindr::solve_circuit(&netlist.circuit)?;
    println!("V(n2) = {:.3} V", op.voltage("n2").unwrap_or(f64::NAN));

    // 3. Dispatch each parsed directive to the matching sindr routine.
    for analysis in &netlist.analyses {
        match analysis {
            AnalysisRequest::Op => {
                sindr::solve_op(&netlist.circuit)?;
            }
            AnalysisRequest::Dc { source, .. } => {
                let (axis, _outer) = analysis.dc_axes().ok_or("not a .dc")??;
                let sweep = sindr::dc_sweep(&netlist.circuit, &axis)?;
                let curve = sweep.node_voltage_curve("n2");
                println!(
                    "dc sweep of {source}: {} points, V(n2) {:.3}..{:.3} V",
                    curve.len(),
                    curve.first().map(|p| p.1).unwrap_or(0.0),
                    curve.last().map(|p| p.1).unwrap_or(0.0),
                );
            }
            AnalysisRequest::Tran { tstop, tstep, .. } => {
                let config = analysis.transient_config().ok_or("not a .tran")?;
                let result = sindr::solve_transient(&netlist.circuit, &config)?;
                let steps = result.transient.map_or(0, |t| t.timesteps.len());
                println!("transient to {tstop} s in {tstep} s steps: {steps} snapshots");
            }
            AnalysisRequest::Ac { fstart, fstop, .. } => match netlist.ac_config() {
                Some(Ok(config)) => {
                    let ac = sindr::ac_analysis::solve_ac(&netlist.circuit, &config)?;
                    println!("ac sweep {fstart}..{fstop} Hz: {} points", ac.points.len());
                }
                // No `AC` spec on a V line: the stimulus has to be set by hand.
                _ => println!("ac sweep {fstart}..{fstop} Hz (no AC source in the deck)"),
            },
            AnalysisRequest::Sens { .. } => {
                let config = analysis.sens_config().ok_or("not a .sens")?;
                let sens = sindr::solve_sensitivity(&netlist.circuit, &config)?;
                println!("sens: {} parameters", sens.entries.len());
            }
            AnalysisRequest::Noise { .. } => {
                let config = analysis.noise_config().ok_or("not a .noise")?;
                let noise = sindr::solve_noise(&netlist.circuit, &config)?;
                println!("noise: {} points", noise.points.len());
            }
            AnalysisRequest::Tf { .. } => {
                let config = analysis.tf_config().ok_or("not a .tf")?;
                let tf = sindr::solve_tf(&netlist.circuit, &config)?;
                println!(
                    "tf: gain {:.4}, input {:.1} Ω, output {:.1} Ω",
                    tf.gain, tf.input_resistance, tf.output_resistance
                );
            }
            AnalysisRequest::Pz { .. } => {
                let config = analysis.pz_config().ok_or("not a .pz")?;
                let pz = sindr::solve_pz(&netlist.circuit, &config)?;
                println!("pz: poles {:?}, zeros {:?}", pz.poles, pz.zeros);
            }
            // Analyses added in later releases.
            other => println!("not run here: {other:?}"),
        }
    }

    // 4. Lenient mode: an unsupported element (B = behavioural source)
    //    becomes a collected warning instead of a hard error.
    let with_behavioural = format!("{DECK}B1 n2 0 V=1\n");
    let opts = ParseOptions::default().with_strict(false);
    let lenient = parse_str_with_options(&with_behavioural, opts)?;
    for warning in &lenient.warnings {
        println!("warning: {warning:?}");
    }

    // 5. Strict mode on a bad deck: render the diagnostic with miette's
    //    fancy reporter for an annotated, underlined span.
    if let Err(e) = parse_str("* bad\nZ1 a b 1\n.end\n") {
        eprintln!("{:?}", miette::Report::new(e));
    }

    Ok(())
}
```

## `sindr/examples/run_example.rs`

```rust
use std::env;

use sindr::{get_examples, solve_circuit};

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let id = env::args().nth(1).ok_or(
        "usage: cargo run --example run_example -- <id>\n\
         (run `cargo run --example list_examples` to see available ids)",
    )?;

    let example = get_examples()
        .into_iter()
        .find(|ex| ex.id == id)
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("no example with id '{id}'"))?;

    println!("=== {} ===", example.name);
    println!("{}\n", example.description);

    let result = solve_circuit(&example.circuit)?;

    let mut nodes: Vec<_> = result.node_voltages.iter().collect();
    nodes.sort_by_key(|(k, _)| (*k).clone());
    println!("Node voltages:");
    for (node, v) in nodes {
        println!("  {:<10} = {:>10.4} V", node, v);
    }

    if !result.bjt_results.is_empty() {
        println!("\nBJT operating points:");
        for bjt in &result.bjt_results {
            println!(
                "  {:<6} Vbe={:.3}V Vce={:.3}V Ic={:.3}mA region={}",
                bjt.id,
                bjt.vbe,
                bjt.vce,
                bjt.ic * 1e3,
                bjt.region
            );
        }
    }

    if let Some(transient) = result.transient {
        let n = transient.timesteps.len();
        if n > 0 {
            let first = &transient.timesteps[0];
            let last = &transient.timesteps[n - 1];
            println!(
                "\nTransient: {n} timesteps, t = {:.6}s → {:.6}s",
                first.time, last.time
            );
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}
```

## `sindr/examples/sensitivity.rs`

```rust
use sindr::{examples, solve_sensitivity, SensConfig, TfOutput};

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let circuit = examples::npn_common_emitter();

    // Which part moves the collector voltage most?
    let config = SensConfig::new(TfOutput::voltage("collector"));
    let sens = solve_sensitivity(&circuit, &config)?;

    println!("=== NPN Common Emitter — .sens V(collector) ===");
    println!("{:>6}\t{:>12}\t{:>14}", "part", "value", "dV per +1%");
    for entry in &sens.entries {
        println!(
            "{:>6}\t{:>12.1}\t{:>11.2} mV",
            entry.component_id,
            entry.value,
            entry.per_percent * 1e3
        );
    }

    Ok(())
}
```

## `sindr/examples/temperature_sweep.rs`

```rust
// Temperature sweep of a forward-biased silicon diode
//
// Topology: V1 (5 V) → R1 (1 kΩ) → D1 (diode) → GND
//
// Run: cargo run -p sindr --example temperature_sweep
//
// Expected output:
//   T(°C)    V_diode(V)
//   The forward drop falls by about 1.7 mV/K as the junction warms
//   (~0.77 V at −23 °C down to ~0.53 V at 127 °C).

use sindr::element::{Diode, Resistor, VoltageSource};
use sindr::TempSweepConfig;
use sindr::{temperature_sweep, Circuit, CircuitElement};

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let circuit = Circuit {
        ground_node: "0".into(),
        components: vec![
            CircuitElement::VoltageSource(VoltageSource {
                id: "V1".into(),
                nodes: ["in".into(), "0".into()],
                voltage: 5.0,
                waveform: None,
            }),
            CircuitElement::Resistor(Resistor {
                id: "R1".into(),
                nodes: ["in".into(), "out".into()],
                resistance: 1_000.0,
            }),
            CircuitElement::Diode(Diode {
                id: "D1".into(),
                nodes: ["out".into(), "0".into()],
                temperature: 300.15, // overridden at each sweep point
                model: None,
            }),
        ],
        ..Default::default()
    };

    // 250 K to 400 K (−23 °C to 127 °C) in 7 points
    let sweep = temperature_sweep(&circuit, &TempSweepConfig::new(250.0, 400.0, 7))?;

    println!("T(°C)\tV_diode(V)");
    for point in &sweep.points {
        println!(
            "{:>6.1}\t{:.4}",
            point.temperature - 273.15,
            point.result.voltage("out").unwrap_or(f64::NAN)
        );
    }

    Ok(())
}
```

use sindr::{examples, solve_tf, TfConfig, TfOutput};

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {

    // How much supply ripple reaches the collector, what the supply sees,
    // and how stiff the collector node is.

    println!("=== NPN Common Emitter — .tf V(collector) Vcc ===");
    println!("gain               = {:.4} V/V", tf.gain);

    println!("output resistance  = {:.1} Ω", tf.output_resistance);

    Ok(())
}

## `sindr/examples/transient_rc.rs`

```rust
use sindr::{examples, solve_circuit};

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let circuit = examples::rc_lowpass_filter();
    let result = solve_circuit(&circuit)?;
    let transient = result
        .transient
        .ok_or("expected transient data — circuit should contain a capacitor")?;

    println!("=== RC Low-Pass Filter — Step Response ===");
    println!("time(s)\t\tV_out(V)");

    let steps = &transient.timesteps;
    let stride = (steps.len() / 25).max(1);
    for (i, snap) in steps.iter().enumerate() {
        if i % stride == 0 {
            let v_out = snap.voltage("n2").unwrap_or(0.0);
            println!("{:.6}\t{:.4}", snap.time, v_out);
        }
    }
    if let Some(last) = steps.last() {
        let v_out = last.voltage("n2").unwrap_or(0.0);
        println!("{:.6}\t{:.4}", last.time, v_out);
    }

    Ok(())
}
```

## `sindr/examples/vs_ngspice.rs`

```rust
//! sindr against ngspice on the same decks: time per call when embedded,
//! parallel throughput, and how both scale with circuit size.
//!
//! ```text
//! cargo run --release -p sindr --example vs_ngspice
//! cargo run --release -p sindr --example vs_ngspice --features spice -- --quick
//! ```
//!
//! Needs `ngspice` on the PATH (macOS: `brew install ngspice`). It isn't
//! part of CI: the runners have no ngspice, and this measures ngspice as much
//! as sindr. The README's "Against ngspice" section quotes its output.
//!
//! Both simulators read the same netlist at their default tolerances. sindr
//! is timed in-process, as a program embedding it calls it. ngspice is timed
//! three ways: spawning `ngspice -b` per run (what a program shelling out to
//! it pays, fastest of several), the same minus the fastest start on a
//! one-resistor deck (its solve alone, roughly), and, for throughput, a `.control` loop that runs every
//! op point in one ngspice process (the fastest way to drive it from batch
//! mode).

use sindr::element::Resistor;
use std::fmt::Write as _;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::{Command, Stdio};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use sindr::ac_analysis::{solve_ac, AcConfig};
use sindr::spice::{parse_file, parse_str};
use sindr::{solve_circuit, solve_transient, Circuit, CircuitElement};

fn golden_dir() -> PathBuf {
    Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("tests/golden")
}

fn scratch() -> PathBuf {
    let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("sindr-vs-ngspice-{}", std::process::id()));
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
    dir
}

/// Mean time of `f`, repeated until `budget` has passed (at least 3 runs).
fn time_in_process(budget: Duration, mut f: impl FnMut()) -> Duration {
    f(); // warm up
    let start = Instant::now();
    let mut runs = 0u32;
    while runs < 3 || start.elapsed() < budget {
        f();
        runs += 1;
    }
    start.elapsed() / runs
}

/// Fastest of `runs` runs of `ngspice -b deck`. The fastest, not the
/// median, because the startup it's compared against is the same, and
/// subtracting one noisy figure from another hides a short solve.
fn time_ngspice(deck: &Path, runs: usize) -> Duration {
    (0..runs)
        .map(|_| {
            let start = Instant::now();
            run_ngspice(deck);
            start.elapsed()
        })
        .min()
        .unwrap()
}

/// ngspice's time beyond starting up, or "< 1 ms" inside the noise.
fn solve_only(ng: Duration, startup: Duration) -> String {
    let d = ng.saturating_sub(startup);
    if d < Duration::from_millis(1) {
        "< 1 ms".into()
    } else {
        fmt(d)
    }
}

fn run_ngspice(deck: &Path) {
    let status = Command::new("ngspice")
        .arg("-b")
        .arg(deck)
        .stdout(Stdio::null())
        .stderr(Stdio::null())
        .status()
        .expect("ngspice on the PATH");
    assert!(status.success(), "ngspice failed on {}", deck.display());
}

/// `netlist` (without `.end`) with `control` as its `.control` block.
fn write_deck(dir: &Path, name: &str, netlist: &str, control: &str) -> PathBuf {
    let body: String = netlist
        .lines()
        .filter(|l| !l.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(".end"))
        .map(|l| format!("{l}\n"))
        .collect();
    let path = dir.join(format!("{name}.cir"));
    std::fs::write(&path, format!("{body}.control\n{control}\n.endc\n.end\n")).unwrap();
    path
}

fn fmt(d: Duration) -> String {
    let s = d.as_secs_f64();
    if s >= 1.0 {
        format!("{s:.2} s")
    } else if s >= 1e-3 {
        format!("{:.2} ms", s * 1e3)
    } else {
        format!("{:.0} µs", s * 1e6)
    }
}

fn ratio(slow: Duration, fast: Duration) -> String {
    format!("{:.0}×", slow.as_secs_f64() / fast.as_secs_f64())
}

struct Settings {
    budget: Duration,
    spawns: usize,
    mc_runs: usize,
    sizes: &'static [usize],
}

fn main() {
    let quick = std::env::args().any(|a| a == "--quick");
    let s = if quick {
        Settings {
            budget: Duration::from_millis(100),
            spawns: 5,
            mc_runs: 200,
            sizes: &[10, 100],
        }
    } else {
        Settings {
            budget: Duration::from_millis(500),
            spawns: 21,
            mc_runs: 1000,
            sizes: &[10, 100, 1000, 3000],
        }
    };
    let dir = scratch();
    let version = Command::new("ngspice")
        .arg("--version")
        .output()
        .map(|o| String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stdout).into_owned())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let version = version
        .lines()
        .find(|l| l.contains("ngspice-"))
        .unwrap_or("ngspice")
        .trim_matches(|c: char| c == '*' || c.is_whitespace());
    println!("{version}, {} threads available\n", threads());

    let empty = write_deck(&dir, "empty", "startup\nR1 a 0 1\n", "op");
    let startup = time_ngspice(&empty, s.spawns);
    println!(
        "Starting ngspice on a one-resistor deck: {}\n",
        fmt(startup)
    );

    per_call(&s, &dir, startup);
    throughput(&s, &dir);
    scaling(&s, &dir, startup);
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
}

fn threads() -> usize {
    std::thread::available_parallelism().map_or(1, |n| n.get())
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------ per call

fn per_call(s: &Settings, dir: &Path, startup: Duration) {
    println!("## Time per call (golden decks)\n");
    println!("| Case | sindr in-process | ngspice -b | ngspice minus startup | vs spawn |");
    println!("|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|");
    let ac = AcConfig::new("v1", 100.0, 100e3, 61);
    let cases: [(&str, &str, &str); 4] = [
        ("op_diode_series", "op", "op"),
        ("op_bjt_ce", "op", "op"),
        (
            "ac_rlc_bandpass",
            "ac, 61 points",
            "alter @v1[acmag] = 1\nac dec 20 100 100k",
        ),
        ("tran_halfwave", "tran, 5 ms of a rectifier", "run"),
    ];
    for (case, label, control) in cases {
        let path = golden_dir().join(format!("{case}.cir"));
        let netlist = parse_file(&path).unwrap();
        let circuit = netlist.circuit.clone();
        let sindr = match case {
            "ac_rlc_bandpass" => time_in_process(s.budget, || {
                solve_ac(&circuit, &ac).unwrap();
            }),
            "tran_halfwave" => {
                let config = netlist.transient_config().unwrap();
                time_in_process(s.budget, || {
                    solve_transient(&circuit, &config).unwrap();
                })
            }
            _ => time_in_process(s.budget, || {
                solve_circuit(&circuit).unwrap();
            }),
        };
        let deck = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap();
        let ng = time_ngspice(&write_deck(dir, case, &deck, control), s.spawns);
        println!(
            "| `{case}` ({label}) | {} | {} | {} | {} |",
            fmt(sindr),
            fmt(ng),
            solve_only(ng, startup),
            ratio(ng, sindr),
        );
    }
    println!();
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------- throughput

/// `op_bjt_ce` with the base resistor drawn ±10 %: a Monte Carlo of op
/// points. A small LCG keeps the example free of a rand dependency.
fn monte_carlo_values(n: usize) -> Vec<f64> {
    let mut state: u64 = 0x2545_f491_4f6c_dd1d;
    (0..n)
        .map(|_| {
            state = state
                .wrapping_mul(6_364_136_223_846_793_005)
                .wrapping_add(1_442_695_040_888_963_407);
            let unit = (state >> 11) as f64 / (1u64 << 53) as f64;
            470e3 * (0.9 + 0.2 * unit)
        })
        .collect()
}

fn with_rb(base: &Circuit, rb: f64) -> Circuit {
    let mut c = base.clone();
    for e in &mut c.components {
        if let CircuitElement::Resistor(Resistor { id, resistance, .. }) = e {
            if id.eq_ignore_ascii_case("rb") {
                *resistance = rb;
            }
        }
    }
    c
}

fn throughput(s: &Settings, dir: &Path) {
    let n = s.mc_runs;
    println!("## Parallel throughput: {n} op points of `op_bjt_ce`, RB ±10 %\n");
    let path = golden_dir().join("op_bjt_ce.cir");
    let base = parse_file(&path).unwrap().circuit;
    let values = monte_carlo_values(n);

    println!("| Runner | Wall time | Op points/s |");
    println!("|---|---:|---:|");
    let row = |label: &str, d: Duration| {
        println!(
            "| {label} | {} | {:.0} |",
            fmt(d),
            n as f64 / d.as_secs_f64()
        );
    };

    let mut counts = vec![1, 2, 4, threads()];
    counts.dedup();
    for t in counts.into_iter().filter(|&t| t <= threads()) {
        let start = Instant::now();
        std::thread::scope(|scope| {
            for chunk in values.chunks(n.div_ceil(t)) {
                let base = &base;
                scope.spawn(move || {
                    for &rb in chunk {
                        solve_circuit(&with_rb(base, rb)).unwrap();
                    }
                });
            }
        });
        row(
            &format!("sindr, {t} thread(s), one process"),
            start.elapsed(),
        );
    }

    // One ngspice process, every op point from a .control loop.
    let deck = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap();
    let mut control = String::new();
    for rb in &values {
        writeln!(control, "alter rb = {rb}\nop\ndestroy all").unwrap();
    }
    let looped = write_deck(dir, "mc_loop", &deck, control.trim_end());
    let start = Instant::now();
    run_ngspice(&looped);
    row("ngspice, one process, .control loop", start.elapsed());

    // A process per op point, as many at once as there are cores.
    let decks: Vec<PathBuf> = values
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(i, rb)| {
            write_deck(
                dir,
                &format!("mc_{i}"),
                &deck,
                &format!("alter rb = {rb}\nop"),
            )
        })
        .collect();
    let start = Instant::now();
    std::thread::scope(|scope| {
        for chunk in decks.chunks(decks.len().div_ceil(threads())) {
            scope.spawn(move || chunk.iter().for_each(|d| run_ngspice(d)));
        }
    });
    row(
        &format!("ngspice -b per point, {} at once", threads()),
        start.elapsed(),
    );
    println!();
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------- scaling

/// `n` diode–resistor stages (the `newton` bench's chain), as a deck.
fn diode_chain(n: usize) -> String {
    let mut d = format!("diode chain, {n} stages\nV1 n0 0 5\n");
    for i in 1..=n {
        let p = i - 1;
        writeln!(d, "R{i} n{p} n{i} 1k\nRP{i} n0 n{i} 10k\nD{i} n{i} 0 dd").unwrap();
    }
    d + ".model dd D(IS=1e-14 N=1)\n.end\n"
}

/// `n` RC stages driven by a 1 V step, 200 fixed steps of 0.1 µs.
fn rc_ladder(n: usize) -> String {
    let mut d = format!("rc ladder, {n} stages\nV1 n0 0 PULSE(0 1 0 1n 1n 1 2)\n");
    for i in 1..=n {
        let p = i - 1;
        writeln!(d, "R{i} n{p} n{i} 100\nC{i} n{i} 0 1n").unwrap();
    }
    d + ".tran 0.1u 20u 0 0.1u\n.end\n"
}

fn scaling(s: &Settings, dir: &Path, startup: Duration) {
    println!("## Scaling with size\n");
    println!("| Circuit | Stages | Nodes | sindr | ngspice -b | ngspice minus startup |");
    println!("|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|");
    let spawns = s.spawns.min(5);
    for &n in s.sizes {
        let text = diode_chain(n);
        let circuit = parse_str(&text).unwrap().circuit;
        let sindr = time_in_process(s.budget, || {
            solve_circuit(&circuit).unwrap();
        });
        let ng = time_ngspice(&write_deck(dir, "chain", &text, "op"), spawns);
        println!(
            "| Diode chain, op | {n} | {} | {} | {} | {} |",
            n + 1,
            fmt(sindr),
            fmt(ng),
            solve_only(ng, startup),
        );
    }
    for &n in s.sizes {
        let text = rc_ladder(n);
        let netlist = parse_str(&text).unwrap();
        let config = netlist.transient_config().unwrap();
        let sindr = time_in_process(s.budget, || {
            solve_transient(&netlist.circuit, &config).unwrap();
        });
        let ng = time_ngspice(&write_deck(dir, "ladder", &text, "run"), spawns);
        println!(
            "| RC ladder, 200-step tran | {n} | {} | {} | {} | {} |",
            n + 1,
            fmt(sindr),
            fmt(ng),
            solve_only(ng, startup),
        );
    }
    println!();
}
```
